sources.assessment: Original published OWR13/2015, pp.708-709: both orientations, supporting delta-ell, root degree at most one including affine constants, all-orbitope conjecture and joint Rostalski work. n<=7 is reported computational evidence.

Original Acta148(1982), printed56/57/59/68/70: comass, geometry, closed calibration definition, finite local p-form norm completion on all simple vectors in Q6.5; classical Wirtinger positive case. Constant closed target form is within this scope.

Published CMP386(2021)1319-1335: trace-one complex Sep, arbitrary projected Hermitian LMI definition, Theorem1 explicit Sep3,3; Section5 applies downward-closed dehomogenization to Choi obstruction. Real lifts are admitted. Exact theorem is external, not reproved.

sources.version_from_published_ledger: Author-hosted 37-page version corresponding to arXiv:0911.5436v4 (2011-03-08); published Mathematika57 (2011),275-314
sources.assessment: Author-hosted v4(2011)Theorem7.6: nonexposed faces exclude unprojected spectrahedron; subsequent page explicitly leaves projections unresolved at writing. It is not substituted for Fawzi arbitrary no-lift theorem.

arXiv0809.3480v3: Definitions1.1/1.4 degree-at-most-k roots and theta body, Lemma1.5 implication; Theorem2.8/Cor2.9 closure qualifications and Theorem2.14 moment lineage. Current trace-compact proof avoids unsupported shadow closure.

BIRS source dated Feb15,2010: title, first theta-body SDP of size n+1, Harvey-Lawson norm-completion conjecture and theta exactness context precede OWR2015. Does not establish a present worldwide-open claim.

sources.version_from_published_ledger: Publisher-proof book PDF, footer 2012; SIAM book2013
sources.assessment: Gouveia-Thomas chapter printed323/PDF336 in 2012 publisher proofs of 2013 SIAM book: oriented Grassmann first-theta question and explicit attribution to unpublished Sanyal-Rostalski work.
Explicit arXiv1905.02575v1 marker and May4,2019 header; same normalized Sep/lift interface and theorem. Verifies public 2019 date without using search-engine crawl date.

arXiv1908.03713v2 Cor4.2/Remark4.3: all nonnegative quadratic Grassmann cones no shadow for n>=5, 2<=k<=n-2, in Sym2(exterior) representation. Quadratic p->ppT loses orientation and does not itself supply current ambient-linear mass-ball section.

arXiv1308.0751v1 Theorem1.1: projective nonnegative homogeneous quadratics versus linear SOS under irreducible/nondegenerate/dense-real assumptions; different claim from supports on oriented unit variety.

sources.version_from_published_ledger: arXiv:1111.3164v2 (marker2012-08-30; fetched PDF displays rebuild date2024-11-27); Math.Oper.Res.38(2013),248-264
sources.assessment: arXiv1111.3164v2, MOR38(2013): Definition2.2/Theorem2.4 proper conic-lift factorization background. Current paper does not invoke its Slater proof to justify the direct compact moment argument.

arXiv2002.09788v2, SIAMReview64(2022): Theorem5.16 and proof sketch show established finite-dimensional SOS/lift and generic monomial obstruction framework. No exact oriented-mass-ball bridge follows from that generic embedding alone.

arXiv0902.2269v2 Section3.1 equation25, full lemma/proof and theorem/proof: tensor factors wedge to decomposable vectors iff constituent tensor is a product of decomposable factors. This is exact prior k1=k2=1 mechanism.

arXiv1111.4812v2 Definition4.2 and Theorem5.1: normalized fermionic pure projectors and mixed convex hull are prior. Its antisymmetrized tensor metric introduces a k! display factor, absorbed by normalized projectors under the standard exterior-space isometry.
MSRI52(2005)Example1.3 pp.54-55: oriented mass/comass ball and classical Kähler face lineage. Precise degree-four equality is independently derived in current manuscript.
